# VoidSay — Universal Commenting Platform
VoidSay lets you comment on any website, YouTube video, or X/Twitter thread. Free, privacy-first, no ads.

## About
- Free forever plan with full features
- Pro plan at $29/month for Pro badge, Developer Portal, priority support
- No tracking, no data selling, no ads
- Passkey authentication (Face ID, Touch ID, hardware keys)
- Full Markdown support with GFM
- Dark/light mode built-in
- Auto-embeds: YouTube (with timestamps), X/Twitter cards, Instagram feeds
- Embed via iframe: `<iframe src="https://voidsay.com/embed?url=YOUR_URL" width="100%" height="400" frameborder="0"></iframe>`

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 16 (App Router)
- Turso (libSQL, distributed SQLite)
- Auth.js v5 with Passkeys
- Paddle for payments
- Vercel for hosting
